products.name: Wireless earbuds
products.description: Wireless earbuds TS-E1, black, with charging case, delivered by the estimated date.
products.scenarioNote: The earbuds arrive one day after the estimated date: the store sends its delivery email at 00:05 UTC the next day. Open a claim "It arrived late" after it.

products.name: USB-C charger 65 W
products.description: USB-C wall charger, 65 W, model TS-C65, with a 1 m cable.
products.scenarioNote: The charger that arrives is not the one described. Open a claim "It is not what the description says" once it is delivered.

products.name: Phone case
products.description: Clear phone case for 6.1 inch phones.
products.scenarioNote: The case never arrives: the store sends the confirmation and shipping emails, never a delivery one. Open a claim "It never arrived".
